Actress Khushbu Sundar defends daughter's wedding post after criticism

Actress Khushbu Sundar has defended a social media post about her daughter's wedding, which drew criticism following the death of actor K. Bhagyaraj. She stated that her daughter had simply gotten married. The controversy arose due to the timing of the post in relation to Bhagyaraj's passing.
